screen.canopycavern.field_guide.title: Canopy Cavern Field Guide
guide.canopycavern.section.basics.title: 1. Vanilla-Plus Exploration
guide.canopycavern.section.basics.body: No RPG stats or skills: survive through smart preparation, cooperative shelters, and upgraded armor or alpine tools.
guide.canopycavern.section.climate.title: 2. Climate, Micro-Weather & Comfort
guide.canopycavern.section.climate.body: High ridges bring frostbite chills and deep humid caves sap stamina. Warm by a lit campfire or inside an enclosed roof to recover.
guide.canopycavern.section.gear.title: 3. Specialty Armor & Tools
guide.canopycavern.section.gear.body: Wear Peak Thermal gear for frost immunity, Mossweave for humid & hot caves + cave Speed, or craft Flare Torches & Relic Compasses.
guide.canopycavern.section.world.title: 4. Revamped Biomes & Villager Cities
guide.canopycavern.section.world.body: Seek redesigned Timber Villages, Crystal Citadels, Treetop Bastions, Echoing Mineshafts, and friendly patrolling Village Sentinels.
blueprint.canopycavern.trailside_camp.de: Quick open timber lean-to with lit campfire, storage & crafting.

advancements.canopycavern.root.descripti: Open your Canopy Field Guide and step into a living Overworld.
advancements.canopycavern.enter_peaks.de: Ascend into the crisp heights of Whispering Peaks.
advancements.canopycavern.find_crystal_s: Reach the sweeping Crystal Steppe plateaus.

advancements.canopycavern.conquer_minesh: Find the sprawling Echoing Mineshaft Hub deep underground.
advancements.canopycavern.attune_compass: Craft a Grotto Relic Compass to track hidden hubs and shrines.
advancements.canopycavern.visit_village_: Visit a revamped Canopy Cavern settlement protected by Village Sentinels.

guide.canopycavern.section.oceans.title: 5. Ocean Mega-Structures & Sunken Armada
guide.canopycavern.section.oceans.body: Explore massive Sunken Citadel Vaults, Thermal Observatories, and Reef Lighthouses hiding dry treasure chambers beneath the waves.
guide.canopycavern.section.ocean_gear.bo: Right-click a Tide Compass to locate Ocean Mega-Structures. Carry a Sea Glass Charm for underwater breath aid and Bubble Pulse.
guide.canopycavern.section.airlock.title: 7. Underwater Airlock Shelters
guide.canopycavern.section.airlock.body: Use the Auto-Shelter tab on seafloors to deploy an instant dry Abyssal Airlock Dome that restores warmth comfort.
guide.canopycavern.section.villages.body: All 5 Overworld village themes feature multi-story halls, markets, busy Villagers, and patrolling Village Sentinels outdoors.
advancements.canopycavern.craft_tide_com: Obtain an Abyssal Tide Compass to chart sunken ocean monuments.
advancements.canopycavern.explore_reef_l: Visit a Reef Lighthouse Keep and seek its sunken flagship vault.

guide.canopycavern.section.sanctuary_hub: An optional multiplayer arrival hub featuring the Central Plaza, Heartroot Tree, Expedition Gate, Guild Hall, Nature Garden, Trading Pavilion, and underground Crystal Grotto.
guide.canopycavern.section.sanctuary_rou: Follow marked trails in all four directions or descend twin Pavilion stairs into the cavern atrium. Three marked stairways guarantee a safe climb back to daylight.
guide.canopycavern.section.sanctuary_saf: Harsh freeze and cave heat calm gently within the hub safe radius. Protected structures prevent accidental griefing while keeping doors, bells, and lecterns usable.
guide.canopycavern.section.sanctuary_adm: Disabled by default (spawnHubEnabled=false). Admins use /canopy sanctuary preflight, preview, backup, install, and optional set-spawn without overwriting beds.
book.canopycavern.canopy_sanctuary_welco:
Welcome to Canopy Sanctuary!

This optional server arrival hub connects surface biomes and subterranean caverns with clear roads, shelter, and safe return routes.

Four Trails From Plaza:

- North: Expedition Gate & Overworld Wilds
- East: Adventurer Guild Hall & Exhibits
- West: Nature Garden & Brook
- South: Trading Pavilion & Crystal Cavern

Your Freedom:

No forced teleports or paywalls stand between you and adventure. Leave via any surface road or climb back out from the underground Crystal Grotto through three marked stairways.
book.canopycavern.guild_field_guide.page:
Field Guide Basics:

Open your personal Canopy Field Guide to read micro-climate hazards, underground thermal balance, and instant emergency camp shelters for expeditions.

Survival Tips:

Inside the central Sanctuary arrival zone, harsh surface frost and cave heat calm gently so new arrivals can orient, read boards, and craft starter gear safely.
book.canopycavern.guild_expedition_route:
Subterranean Descent:

Twin broad staircases on the South Pavilion descend into the Upper Cavern Atrium and overlook the vaulted Crystal Grotto Gallery.

Guaranteed Safe Exit:

Never trap yourself below ground: the West Stair, East Stair, and South Daylight Escape Stair lead directly back up to open daylight.
